options.orbit: Threshold, then a central void. You pass between two objects and a screen just inside the door, then circle one hero object standing alone in a large empty void ringed by six small objects. Product stations sit at the four outer corners, outside the loop. The pay desk closes the loop at the back. Size: default 20 x 16 m.
options.field: One open low field. A floor strip leads from the door to a single large hero object; four sculptural stations hold the product in a loose ring around it, and the route wanders between them to the pay at the back right. Nothing but the hero is tall. Size: default 16 x 12 m.
options.chamber: A room inside the room. A walled chamber with two side openings stands in the middle; three low monoliths inside it carry the product; two blocks break through the chamber walls. The route enters the chamber, circles the monoliths and leaves. There is no single hero: the chamber is the event. Size: default 18 x 12 m.
options.ritual: A small ritual room. Shelf walls wrap the left, right and back; one object at the centre is where you pause first; a counter sits at the back. The route circles the centre, then follows the shelves. Size: default 12 x 10 m.

reply.title: Submerged Luminescence
reply.subtitle: A dry 1970s pool basin where light ripples in place of water.
reply.line: You walk the floor of a drained concrete pool where caustic light reflections dance across the surfaces to guide your discovery of eyewear.
reply.synopsis: You descend into the void, leaving the world behind as you pass between polished concrete pillars and a shimmering aluminum veil. The drained basin centers the space, drawing your gaze toward its brass floor as light filters through a textile ceiling to mimic the movement of water. As you circle the deep end, you uncover sunken glass cases tucked into the corners, inviting you to pause and inspect the collection. Finally, you reach the attendant station, completing your journey through this ethereal, architectural memory.
reply.quote: We replace the weight of water with the fluidity of light to redefine the act of observation.

why.meaning: The narrow gap forces you to slow your pace and mentally shift from the street to the subterranean pool environment.
The expansive distance around the central brass basin creates a sense of isolation that elevates the product to a sculptural centerpiece.
By positioning display cases at the corners, the layout encourages you to turn away from the center to engage in intimate product interaction.
The placement of the attendant station at the rear anchors your path, providing a definitive conclusion to the circular exploration of the pool.
